A '''star''' was the [[Star/Legends|sun]] of the [[Cholganna system/Legends|Cholganna system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Be'ekk]], [[Chol]], [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] and [[Ryien]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chol first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.

*''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' {{1st}}
